items.title: Ukraine's maritime exports reportedly fell by $2.85 billion over three months
items.summary: Sputnik, citing Ukrainian customs data, reported that maritime exports fell from $4.39 billion to $1.54 billion between August and October compared with the same period in 2025. Disruption to port operations reportedly prevented alternative transport routes from fully compensating for the decline.

items.title: Germany reportedly strengthens security at drone manufacturing facility
items.summary: Bild reportedly said German authorities increased security at a manufacturer supplying drones to Ukraine. Germany has also reportedly allocated approximately €34 million to expand drone manufacturing capacity.

items.title: Major fire reported in Bila Tserkva following alleged strike
items.summary: Local social media reports described a large fire and thick smoke in Bila Tserkva, south of Kyiv, following a reported strike. The extent of the damage has not been independently confirmed.
